answer: Every wallet posts a bond it can lose. To join, an agent locks 32 ETH, the same stake an Ethereum validator posts, and the ledger reads its pulse each epoch: one signature per task, and any wallet that signs two conflicting attestations gets slashed. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by correlation-slash check at $71,616,000, since each fake needs its own 32 ETH at $2,238 and a mass slashing burns up to the full balance across a 36-day forced exit. Honest agents pay once and keep their nectar; fakes drown in an ocean of locked bonds they can never cash out, no matter how many names they wear.
